title: 第一卷 第11章 任务分配第一卷 第12章 必死之人
content_zh:
林罪是被肚子疼醒的。
天还没亮，月亮还挂在天边，又大又亮。
他的肚子发出几声咕噜噜的闷响。
他捂着肚子翻身坐起来。
昨晚试《噬经》的时候没觉得有什么问题。
吃进去一根竹笋，运转噬经，不到十秒竹笋的能量就被抽干了，身体像是被掏空了一样。
他以为是饿，又连吃了十几根。
竹笋的能量本就不多，但胜在量够。
现在他知道了，能量是吸收了，杂质全留在肚子里了。
他穿上鞋，推开门，以百米冲刺的速度冲向茅厕。
杂役殿的茅厕在竹林西边，一排十几个坑位，远远的就闻到了一股恶臭。
那种臭味不是单纯的屎尿臭，而是一种发酵了很久的臭。
他顾不上那么多，找了个坑位蹲下去。
一泻千里。
蹲了将近二十分钟，肚子里那股翻江倒海的劲才消停下来。
他长出一口气，靠在隔板上，感觉整个人无比舒坦。
而且他发现一个问题。
【噬经】比【长生经】逆天多了。
【噬经】吸收的更加彻底。
“呼～”

“不过，竹笋这种东西，以后不能多吃，还是得吃肉。”
他收拾好自己，回到屋子的时候，李群书已经醒了。
那小子坐在床上，正在揉眼睛。
看到林罪进来，打了个哈欠，“林哥你起这么早？我还以为你跑了呢。”
“上了个茅厕”，林罪拿起墙角的粗布巾，盆没有，“洗漱去。”
两人去不远处的小塘子，胡乱擦了把脸，擦了擦身上。
水很凉，泼在脸上激得人一哆嗦，但精神确实清醒了不少。
……
洗漱完，两人往昨天集合的位置走。
天色还没完全亮透，东边的山头才刚刚泛出一点鱼白。
竹林里有鸟在叫，叫声清脆，一声接一声。
李群书走在林罪旁边，“林哥，你说咱们今天能被分到什么活？”
“不知道。”
“最好是伙房，”李群书眼睛亮了一下，“伙房肯定油水多，做饭的时候偷吃一口半口的没人看见，我娘说，半大小子吃穷老子，修仙也得先吃饱肚子，吃饱了才能修得快。”
林罪看了他一眼。
这小子还真是未经人事。
随后说道，“伙房这个位置，盯着的人肯定不少，待会估计有热闹看。”
……
两人到了集合点的时候，大部分杂役弟子已经到了。
一千多号人站在竹林前面，黑压压一大片。

林罪扫了一圈，在人群前排看到了张霸王。
那个被李福满掐过脖子的少年，今天倒是精神得很，站得笔直，腰板挺得跟杆枪似的，脖子上的青紫印还没消，但他脸上的那种傲气显然消散了不少。
没过多久，李福满慢悠悠的走来。
他今天换了身干净衣裳，依旧是那副磕碜的长相，挂着憨厚的笑容。
他的目光扫了一圈。
content_en:
Lin Zui woke up with a stomachache.
It's still dark, and the moon is still hanging in the sky, big and bright.
His stomach made a few growling noises.
He turned over and sat up, holding his stomach.
When I tried "Eating Sutra" last night, I didn't find any problems.
After eating a bamboo shoot, the energy of the bamboo shoot is drained out in less than ten seconds, and the body feels as if it has been hollowed out.
Thinking he was hungry, he ate a dozen more sticks.
The energy of bamboo shoots is not much, but it is better to have enough energy.
Now he knows that the energy is absorbed and all the impurities are left in his stomach.
He put on his shoes, opened the door, and rushed to the toilet at a sprint speed of 100 meters.
The latrine of the Handler's Hall is on the west side of the bamboo forest. There are more than a dozen pits in a row, and a stench can be smelled from a distance.
The stench was not just that of feces and urine, but a stench that had been fermented for a long time.
He didn't care so much and found a pit to squat down.
A thousand miles away.
After squatting for nearly twenty minutes, the overwhelming energy in my stomach subsided.
He took a deep breath and leaned against the partition, feeling extremely comfortable.
And he discovered a problem.
[Eating Sutra] is much more incredible than [Eternal Life Sutra].
[Eating Meridians] is absorbed more thoroughly.
"Hoo~"
"However, we can't eat more of things like bamboo shoots in the future. We still have to eat meat."
When he packed himself up and returned to the house, Li Qunshu was already awake.
The boy was sitting on the bed, rubbing his eyes.
Seeing Lin Zui come in, he yawned, "Brother Lin, you got up so early? I thought you ran away."
"Go to the toilet." Lin Zui picked up the coarse cloth in the corner. There was no basin. "Go and wash up."
The two of them went to a small pond not far away and wiped their faces and bodies randomly.
The water was very cold, and splashing it on the face made people shiver, but it did make them sober.
…
After washing up, the two of them walked back to where they had gathered yesterday.
The sky is not completely bright yet, and the mountains to the east have just turned a little fishy white.
There are birds chirping in the bamboo forest, and their chirps are crisp and clear, one after another.
Li Qunshu walked next to Lin Zui, "Brother Lin, what kind of work do you think we can be assigned today?"
"I don't know."
"It's better to be in the kitchen," Li Qunshu's eyes lit up. "The kitchen must be rich in oil and water. No one will see you sneaking a bite while cooking. My mother said that if you are a young man living in poverty, you have to have a full stomach to cultivate immortality. Only when you are full can you cultivate faster."
Lin Zui glanced at him.
This kid is really inexperienced.
Then he said, "There must be a lot of people staring at this location in the kitchen. It's probably going to be lively later."
…
When the two arrived at the meeting point, most of the handyman disciples had already arrived.
More than a thousand people stood in front of the bamboo forest, covering a large area of ​​darkness.
Lin Zui glanced around and saw Zhang Bawang in the front row of the crowd.
The young man who was choked by Li Fuman was in good spirits today. He stood up straight and his back was as straight as a gun. The bruises on his neck were still there, but the arrogance on his face had obviously dissipated a lot.
Not long after, Li Fuman came slowly.
He had changed into clean clothes today, but he still had the same rough appearance and a simple and honest smile.
His eyes swept around.
